---
title: "Teaching"
---

My teaching focuses on helping students use analytical methods to make sound operational and managerial decisions.

## Xavier University

### Operations and Supply Chain Management

Undergraduate course covering process analysis, capacity, inventory, quality, supply chains, and operational decision-making.

### Logistics

Undergraduate course examining transportation, distribution, warehousing, fulfillment, and logistics-system design.

### Business Analytics for Managers

Graduate course introducing quantitative and analytical tools for managerial decision-making.

### Discrete-Event Simulation

Graduate course covering simulation modeling, experimentation, output analysis, and operational applications.

### Quality and Productivity in Operations

Undergraduate course addressing process improvement, quality management, productivity, and operational performance.

## Teaching Interests

- Operations management
- Logistics and supply chain management
- Business statistics
- Quantitative analysis
- Optimization
- Discrete-event simulation
